evidence.title: GitHub - Mobilecn-UI/nativecn-ui: Beautiful and customizable React Native components

name: nativecn-ui
summary: Copy-paste React Native components for Expo with NativeWind, CSS variables and built-in dark mode.
description: A CLI-based collection of React Native components inspired by shadcn/ui. From an Expo project root, npx nativecn-ui init sets things up and npx nativecn-ui add (or add -a for all) copies components into your app. Styling uses NativeWind/Tailwind with CSS variables, so light and dark themes work with a mode toggle. The set includes avatar, badge, button, card, checkbox, dialog, dropdown, input, progress, radio group, select, skeleton, switch, tabs, toast and toggle; alert and form are marked work in progress. Docs live at nativecn.mintlify.app. MIT licensed.
contains: 15+ components incl. avatar, button, card, dialog, input, progress, select, switch, tabs, toast
alert and form marked work in progress
CLI: npx nativecn-ui init and npx nativecn-ui add
dark mode via CSS variables and NativeWind
